title: fix(console): a nav entry with no icon draws its object's icon, record labels in one style, a small count axis fits, a failed entry load retries (#30126)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuJQma3chFJMvv899DugzEi9)_

Part of #30126

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. **What:** the console rows of #30126 that still reproduce on `main` and are fixed in `ui/**`: rows 4, 6, 11 and 14. Rows 5 and 10 do not reproduce (readings below). Row 8 reproduces, but its fix is a server object definition, outside this PR.
2. **Row 4:** an `object` nav entry with no `icon` draws the icon its object declares, in the sidebar and in the `nav:menu` block. It reads the object by name from metadata the console already holds, adds no request and writes nothing to the navigation.
3. **Row 6:** a record section's field labels drop the uppercase transform, so `REPAIR COST` no longer reads in capitals beside `负责人`. They now use the highlights strip's label class.
4. **Row 11:** a count axis whose largest value is 1 to 3 tops out at that value, so one record's bar is full height (362×71 → 362×282 px).
5. **Row 14:** an entry script that fails to load before mount makes the page reload itself, backing off from 1 s and doubling (1/2/4/8/16 s), at most 5 times per tab. Before, the splash stayed forever.
6. **Contract:** `@object-ui/layout` gains `resolveNavItemIcon`, `NavIconTarget`, `NavTargetIconResolver` and an optional `resolveTargetIcon` prop on `NavigationRenderer`, which mirrors `resolveTargetLabel`. That is a widening, so `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (the claim said `no`, and the seat corrects it). No metadata key, no i18n key, nothing under `packages/**`.

## What changes

- `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`: `resolveNavItemIcon(item, resolver)` returns the authored icon; failing that, for an `object` entry, the resolver's answer; otherwise `undefined` (the generic icon). The leaf row, including rows inside groups, draws it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavTargetIcon.ts` (new): the console's resolver. It reads `readObjectsByName` from the metadata cache, the same by-name read the entry's label already makes. It is wired into `UnifiedSidebar` (app arm) and `nav-menu-renderer`, and added to the `openPathObjectReaders-12811` census as a `byName` reader.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: the field label class goes from `text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide` to `text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground` (the `HeaderHighlight` label class).
- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` + `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`: `wholeNumberTickCount(axis, values)` gives `max + 1` ticks when every value is a non-negative integer, `1 ≤ max ≤ 3`, and the axis has no authored `min`/`max`/`stepSize`. Otherwise it returns `undefined`, and the axis is drawn as before. This is not exported from the package index.
- `ui/apps/console/index.html`: the boot splash adds a capture `error` listener for a failed `type=module` entry script before mount. It keeps a per-tab retry count in `sessionStorage` (`os-boot-entry-retries`, max 5), backs off 1/2/4/8/16 s, clears the count on mount, and does not retry where storage is blocked. The splash still ships no copy.

## Row readings (real stack, `origin/main` `c045c341`, showcase app, zh, 1440×900 unless noted)

| row | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 4 sidebar icons | all 6 Walkthrough rows `file-text` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row4-sidebar.png?raw=true)) | `folder-kanban` / `check-square` / `building` / `receipt`, the dashboard row stays `file-text` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/after-row4-sidebar.png?raw=true)) |
| 5 Setup collapsed sidebar | **not reproduced**: hovering a collapsed icon shows its tooltip, both collapsed by hand at 1440 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row5-setup-collapsed-hover.png?raw=true)) and on the auto rail at 1280 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-1280-row5-1280-rail-hover.png?raw=true), tooltip `Users`). The Setup labels are English in zh, which belongs to #30504. | no change |
| 6 record labels | Field Zoo: `负责人` beside `EMAIL` / `PHONE` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row6-fieldzoo.png?raw=true)); en project record: `OWNER EMAIL`, `SPENT`, `START DATE` in capitals ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-en-row6-record.png?raw=true)) | one style, as authored ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/after-row6-fieldzoo.png?raw=true)) |
| 8 inbox topic | **reproduces**: the `sys_inbox_message` view `mine` shows the raw topic `notify` ([list](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row8-list.png?raw=true), [popover](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row8-popover.png?raw=true)). The column list is in `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/inbox-message.object.ts`, outside `ui/**`, so it is left for the server lane. | no change |
| 10 toast over assignee | **not reproduced**: 1440 page: toast y53–107, assignee y249–291 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row10-toast.png?raw=true)); 1440 drawer: toast x340, drawer from x720 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row10-toast-drawer.png?raw=true)); 1024 drawer: toast y136–190, assignee y249 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-1024-row10-toast-drawer.png?raw=true)) | no change |
| 11 one-bar count | axis 0–4, bar 362×71 in a 510×350 plot ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/before-row11-one-bar.png?raw=true)) | axis 0–1, bar 362×282 ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/a0ade7b68805c95f9a86334eea71f905f3578e12/evidence/30126/after-row11-one-bar.png?raw=true)) |

Row 14 was emulated with a Playwright route abort on the entry chunk, not with a real `os dev` restart.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.iconInheritsObject-30126.test.tsx` (5): the resolver's precedence and controls, plus rows at the top level and in a group.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/nav-icon-inherits-object-30126.render.test.tsx` (3): both surfaces against one `MetadataCtx`. It checks that an authored icon stays, an object with no icon and a dashboard entry keep the generic glyph, and a changed object icon shows on rerender with the navigation unchanged.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.labelStyle-30126.test.tsx` (2): Latin and CJK labels share one class with no `uppercase`, and match the highlights strip.
- `ChartRenderer.integerMeasureTicks-11681.test.tsx`: plus 6 tests for the small-count axis and its controls (fractional, count ≥ 4, authored max).
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/bootSplash.test.ts`: plus 5 tests for the retry, back-off, cap, reset on mount, and storage blocked.
- Ablations, each reverted with the restore diff at 0 lines, and each turned its tests red: the sidebar leaf back to `item.icon`, the `nav:menu` row back to `item.icon`, `uppercase` restored on the section label, the axis `tickCount` spread dropped, the splash's `location.reload()` removed, and the reset of the retry count on mount removed.

## Verification

- Type-check exit 0: `@object-ui/layout`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-charts`, `app-shell` (re-run after the `main` merge), `console`.
- eslint on the 14 changed source/test files: 0 errors (warnings pre-existing; the one new `any` warning in `bootSplash.test.ts` fixed).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 36 derived families plus `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`, all exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was OOM-killed beside the loop and passed run alone: 170 files passed (2 skipped), 4985 tests.
- After merging `origin/main` (`f33b094f`): `vitest run packages/layout/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/plugin-charts/ apps/console/src/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/` + the `openPathObjectReaders-12811` census: 923 files passed (1 skipped), 8557 tests passed (27 skipped).
- Evidence: shots at `a0ade7b6` (`evidence/30126/`, removed from the tree by the next commit).

## Acceptance notes

- Open question for the seat (row 11): the one bar is still 362 px wide. Capping `maxBarSize` would change every bar chart, so it was left alone.
- Row 8's fix (`columns` of view `mine`) and rows 9, 12, 13, 15, 16 stay on the card.
